name: Review Summary
summary: Read-only aggregate rating, review count, and optional target-supplied rating distribution.

anatomy.name: average
anatomy.description: Group containing the visible aggregate score, optional Star Rating composition, and review count.

anatomy.name: rating
anatomy.description: Optional composed Star Rating that visualizes the same aggregate score without replacing readable text.

anatomy.name: barRow
anatomy.description: Repeated distribution row for one target-defined rating bucket.

anatomy.name: barTrack
anatomy.description: Passive visual track for one distribution value.

anatomy.name: barFill
anatomy.description: Passive visual fill whose width is supplied by the target.

anatomy.name: barCount
anatomy.description: Visible target-formatted count for one rating bucket.

properties.name: ratingValue
properties.description: Aggregate rating value supplied by the target; the contract does not define how it is calculated.

properties.name: ratingLabel
properties.description: Accessible aggregate-rating text, such as 4.5 out of 5 stars.

properties.name: reviewCount
properties.description: Total review count supplied by the target; the contract does not synchronize or aggregate records.

properties.name: reviewCountLabel
properties.description: Visible target-formatted review count, including any surrounding label.

properties.name: distribution
properties.description: Optional target-owned rating-distribution rows with visible bucket labels and counts.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Responsive summary that stacks when available inline space is narrow.

behavior.name: readOnlyAggregate
behavior.description: The summary displays supplied values only; calculation, moderation, filtering, and synchronization remain target responsibilities.

behavior.name: distributionText
behavior.description: Every supplied distribution width has equivalent visible bucket and count text.

accessibility: Expose the aggregate score and total as readable text rather than only stars or bar widths.
Provide an accessible rating label that includes the value and scale.
Every distribution bar needs visible bucket and count text; do not rely on width or color alone.
Do not announce passive aggregate data as a live region unless the consuming target has a separate update requirement.

web.notes: Canonical responsive presentation is implemented in components/css/reviews.css; aggregate data is target supplied.

shopify.notes: A future adapter must select a review data source without changing this passive display contract.
